audience: social media managers who plan and report posts for brands on Metricool

useCases.title: Review next week's scheduled posts
useCases.text: List the scheduled and published posts in a date range, with their networks. Open one post to read its text and publication date.

useCases.title: Draft a post for a later date
useCases.text: Create a post for the brand. It is saved as a draft unless you set draft to false. Read the post back to check its text and date.

useCases.title: Find the best times to publish
useCases.text: Read the best times to publish on one network in a date range. Networks are Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube.

useCases.title: Measure how posts performed
useCases.text: Read the metrics of published posts for a date range, across all networks. Read one engagement metric for one network, such as impressions.

useCases.title: Work through the content library
useCases.text: List the library posts and the workflow states, such as Draft or Approved. Open one library post to read it.

useCases.title: Delete a scheduled post
useCases.text: Read a scheduled post, then delete it. The post is removed from the planner and is not published.
